targeting_context.target_title: Manager of Applied AI Architecture, Partnerships
targeting_context.jd_text:
Manager of Applied AI Architecture, Partnerships
San Francisco, CA | New York City, NY | Seattle, WA

About Anthropic

Anthropic's mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

About the role

As the Manager of the Partnerships Applied AI Solutions Architect team, you will drive adoption of frontier AI by enabling deployment of Anthropic's products (Claude for Enterprise, Claude Code, API) through our Global and Regional System Integrators, cloud partners (AWS, GCP, Azure), and strategic technology partners.

You will build and lead a team of Partner Solutions Architects, establish processes and best practices for partner-led pre-sales engagements, and represent Anthropic as the technical lead on its most important partnerships. In collaboration with Sales, Partnerships, Product, and Engineering, you will help partners incorporate leading-edge AI into their practices, accelerate indirect revenue, and execute long-term GTM strategy while maintaining our best-in-class safety standards.

Responsibilities

    Team Leadership & Development: Hire, manage, and mentor a team of Partner Solutions Architects. Set goals, run reviews, and coach each team member toward high productivity and career growth.
    Strategic Technical Partnership: Act as the senior technical thought partner to Anthropic's GTM partnerships team. Co-build partner strategy with aligned GTM leadership, drive key programs, and align cross-functional stakeholders (Sales, Product, Engineering) behind partner outcomes.
    Partner Enablement & Ecosystem: Embed your team with GSI and cloud partner technical teams to enable their AI practices, troubleshoot, and evangelize Anthropic in their developer communities. Represent Anthropic at partner events (GSI workshops, AWS/GCP summits, hackathons) and contribute technical content and thought leadership.
    Joint Solution Development: Lead partners in identifying high-value, industry-specific GenAI applications. Develop joint solutions and codify reference architectures and best practices to accelerate time to deployment.
    Customer Deal Support: Own the technical portion of partner-led pre-sales engagements. Intervene directly on strategic deals where partners are the primary delivery vehicle, providing deep solution architecture guidance.
    Product Feedback: Gather and validate feedback on Anthropic's products from partner deployments and deliver it to Product and Engineering to inform roadmap and partner strategy.

You may be a good fit if you have

    7+ years in technical customer-facing or partner-facing roles (Solutions Architect, Sales Engineer, Partner SE, TAM).
    3+ years managing pre-sales or partner-facing technical teams; comfortable building foundational teams in ambiguous, fast-moving environments.
    Track record building and scaling partnerships with GSIs (e.g., Accenture, Deloitte, TCS, Infosys) and/or cloud providers (AWS, GCP, Azure).
    Deep understanding of partner-led selling and delivery: indirect revenue models, enablement at scale, and joint GTM motions.
    Technical depth in enterprise AI deployments: LLM architecture, prompt engineering, evaluation, API integrations, and production use cases.
    Exceptional communication and executive presence; able to build trusted relationships with C-suite, partner leadership, and engineering teams alike.
    A love of teaching and mentoring, and a passion for advancing safe, beneficial AI.

Strong candidates may also have

    5+ years leading partner-facing SA teams through hypergrowth, including developing both senior and junior talent.
    Direct experience helping GSIs or consultancies build their AI/ML practice - enablement programs, certification paths, joint solution development.

Compensation

The annual compensation range for this role is listed below.

For sales roles, the range provided is the role's On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role.

Annual Salary: $315,000 - $380,000 USD

# Anthropic - Manager of Applied AI Architecture, Partnerships briefing packet
| Manager of Applied AI Architecture, Partnerships | $315,000–$380,000 USD | Reports to Partnerships (partner GTM context) |

## JD Complement
This leadership seat is best understood as an ecosystem-scale architecture and quality function. The central challenge is expanding enterprise access to Claude through external delivery organizations while preserving a consistent,
trustworthy customer experience.

The core tension is leverage versus control. Partners can broaden technical reach, industry coverage, and implementation capacity; uneven designs, weak enablement, or unclear operating boundaries could erode confidence in a
safety-centered AI company.

## Company DNA & Operating Model
Anthropic is a San Francisco-based public benefit corporation focused on AI research and safety, with Claude as its primary product family. Its public identity emphasizes dependable, understandable, and controllable AI.

The company operates as both a frontier-model builder and an enterprise platform business. Winning requires strong underlying technology as well as confidence that organizations can introduce, govern, and expand its use responsibly.

That combination makes implementation quality strategically important. Enterprise adoption depends on more than access to a model: customers need secure operating patterns, practical workflow integration, informed users, and clear paths
from initial use to sustained value.

Safety is therefore a commercial differentiator as well as a research principle. External ecosystem participants need practical ways to translate that principle into customer-facing technical decisions.

## Company Strategy & Operating Pressure
Anthropic is extending Claude across enterprise offerings, developer use cases, and API-based applications. The likely operating imperative is to convert broad market interest into durable, scalable organizational usage.

Its enterprise adoption materials frame rollout as a lifecycle covering setup, organizational launch, user education, and scaled adoption. This implies a higher bar for ecosystem readiness than certifications or pipeline contribution
alone.

A strong partner motion must help customers manage technical, operational, and behavioral change. The most useful external firms will not merely introduce Claude; they will make deployments repeatable, supportable, and extensible.

A likely decision-rights challenge sits between central standards from product, engineering, security, and safety functions and distributed delivery across external firms. The architecture organization can make those standards usable
without turning every engagement into a central-team exception.

## Leadership & Stakeholder Map
Anthropic spans research, engineering, policy, and commercial functions. For this role, functional alignment matters more than a formal reporting chart.

- Partnerships and revenue teams need credible technical capacity that improves ecosystem-led opportunity execution.
- Security, compliance, and enterprise-product teams influence the boundaries of sound customer designs and partner commitments.
- Developer and platform teams shape the experience for API users and production application builders.
- Cloud, technology, and services firms provide distribution, implementation capacity, and specialized domain knowledge.

Internal credibility will come from disciplined translation: distinguish isolated account demands from repeatable patterns that merit changes in product, documentation, training, architecture assets, or partner policy.

## AI, Data, Platform, Architecture Signals
Claude is positioned for business users, developers, and organizations building applications through APIs. Those routes create different technical needs but should share a coherent enterprise architecture vocabulary.

The relevant design conversation is broader than model selection. It includes access controls, application integration, evaluation practices, operational reliability, workflow fit, user adoption, and ongoing governance.

Enterprise materials emphasize security, compliance, technical configuration, enablement, and adoption expansion. This suggests success will be judged by practical deployability and sustained usage, rather than demonstrations alone.

Anthropic’s emphasis on reliability, interpretability, and steerability provides a distinctive architectural design center. Partners need patterns that help customers operate advanced AI with appropriate controls and realistic expectations.

## Partnership / Ecosystem Motion
Anthropic publicly identifies cloud, technology, and services firms as major ecosystem categories. Each contributes a different part of the enterprise adoption system.

- Cloud firms provide established infrastructure, procurement relationships, and enterprise routes to market.
- Technology firms can incorporate Claude into business software, workflows, and complementary platforms.
- Services firms add implementation expertise, industry context, organizational change support, and managed delivery capacity.
- Ecosystem programs require coordinated building, marketing, and selling rather than a referral-only operating model.
- Reusable solution designs and clear delivery boundaries are essential to making partner capacity reliable at scale.

The strategic opportunity is to turn partner expertise into a compounding asset: common technical patterns, predictable customer outcomes, credible field feedback, and an ecosystem that increases capacity without fragmenting the customer
experience.

## Recent Events & Urgency
Anthropic’s enterprise guidance treats adoption as an ongoing operating journey rather than a one-time technical launch. That increases the importance of external firms able to support customers after initial activation.

Reported expansion of the Claude Partner Network, including training and enablement infrastructure, suggests a more systematic ecosystem approach. As external capacity grows, the cost of unclear quality standards and inconsistent
technical practices rises quickly.

Competitive pressure extends beyond model capability. Enterprise buyers can choose cloud platforms, model providers, and consultancies with established implementation relationships. Anthropic’s advantage will depend partly on how
effectively others can help customers realize value while retaining confidence in the company’s approach to safety and reliability.

## apps_rg Positioning Themes (targeting only, not proof)
- Ecosystem technical strategy that converts platform capability into repeatable enterprise adoption patterns.
- Architecture leadership across cloud, software, and services delivery partners.
- Reusable technical assets, operating standards, and industry-oriented solution blueprints.
- Governance-aware enterprise AI design, spanning security, compliance, reliability, and responsible use.
- Cross-functional influence among commercial, product, engineering, and external technical organizations.
- Adoption design that connects implementation, user enablement, operational readiness, and usage growth.
- Structured field intelligence that separates scalable product opportunities from isolated customer exceptions.
- Team formation and coaching in fast-changing, partner-centered environments.

## apps_lic Outreach Angles (targeting only, not proof)
- Anthropic’s ecosystem spans cloud, technology, and services firms, making delivery consistency a meaningful scaling question.
- A safety-centered company has unusually high stakes for the quality of external technical delivery.
- This position sits where ecosystem expansion and trusted enterprise implementation must reinforce one another.

## Do Not Use As Proof
The JD and this briefing are targeting inputs only. Candidate claims must come from the governed resume/proof graph.
